question: From what source is the Veda-Agama said to have arisen?
premises: It is said to be born from the upward face.
This origin is to be regarded as such.
inference: The Veda-Agama is to be regarded as born from the upward face.
uncertainties: The possessor of the upward face is implied by context.
plain_english: Let the Veda-Agama be regarded as born from my upward face.
